printedrobotics.cz prints parts and assembles kits from open-source robot projects published by their authors. The authors are not affiliated with us and have not endorsed our kits. All projects belong to their authors.

01 — Licences

Which projects we can offer as kits

We check the licence of the design files separately from the software licence. Projects with a non-commercial (NC) clause are offered only with the authors’ written consent. Every kit page links to the project’s source files and guide and names its authors and licences.

02 — Safety

Not a toy. Kits contain small parts — choking hazard.

For ages 14 and up; younger children only under adult supervision. Moving parts can pinch fingers. Each kit page lists the safety notes that apply to that robot (batteries, strong motors, combat robots, spinning weapons).

Power the hardware only from the supply specified in the project instructions. Only power up a combat robot in an enclosed arena or with the weapon disconnected.

03 — Your email

Pre-orders, availability alerts, questions and newsletter sign-ups send us the email address and the details you enter in the form (for a pre-order: the chosen configuration, quantity and optional note). We use them only to answer you or to send what you asked for, and we never share your address.

Pre-orders are non-binding: we confirm the price and date by email and you pay only after you confirm. You can unsubscribe from any email by replying to it.

Full manufacturer details, the declaration of conformity and terms of sale will be published before sales begin.
